structure.layout: mobile-style single-column app screen (640px centered column on black) with large title header, segmented tabs, a mode toggle card, a stacked list of weekday routine rows, and a floating pill bottom tab bar with a raised circular Start button

aesthetics.typography: System font stack (-apple-system / SF-style, falls back to DejaVu-like sans in capture) used throughout: bold large title, regular body rows, medium weights for active segments and tab labels
aesthetics.typeScale: iOS-like: 34px/700 large title, 17px row titles and card headings, 15–16px segmented tabs/subtitle, 13px captions and secondary text, 11px/500 tab bar labels; hierarchy driven mostly by size and white vs dimmed #ebebf5 at reduced opacity

notes: Web app imitating an iOS dark-mode app (Apple system colors: #1c1c1e grouped surfaces, #30d158 system green, #ff9f0a orange, #5e5ce6 indigo) confined to a 640px column on a pure black page. Distinctive: each routine row carries a tiny front+back anatomical body diagram (SVG) with trained muscles lit in green; today's day abbreviation ('Tu') is green. The floating rounded bottom tab bar has a raised circular green Start (play) button overlapping its top edge, and it overlays the last content row in the capture. Segmented controls use a #636366 lighter pill as the selected thumb. Rotation mode reveals an empty state ('No rotation yet…') and Routines tab shows folders (Archive, Travel) with Edit / New routine — not in capture.
